checks.claim: 生平：1743-04-13沙德韦尔生、威廉玛丽学院、独立宣言起草委员会、弗吉尼亚州长、驻法公使、国务卿、副总统、总统（1801-1809）、蒙蒂塞洛晚年与弗吉尼亚大学创办、1826-07-04卒（与亚当·斯密同年逝）。
checks.locator: §1 Life and Writings（原读录：born 13 April 1743 Shadwell; William and Mary; Declaration drafting; Virginia governor; minister to France; Secretary of State; president 1801-1809; University of Virginia; died 4 July 1826 Monticello）

checks.claim: 自然权利与不可让渡的权利（生命/自由/追求幸福）、宗教自由与政教分离（弗吉尼亚宗教自由法）、有限政府、对奴隶制的矛盾（写下平等的人与奴隶主共生）、文字与行为的落差。
checks.locator: 独立宣言全文（原读录：'We hold these truths to be self-evident, that all men are created equal…endowed by their Creator with certain unalienable Rights, that among these are Life, Liberty and the pursuit of Happiness'）＋sep-jefferson原读录（§1 Life and Writings on slavery contradiction）
